camel_example: aliyun ga CreateCustomRoutingEndpointGroups --region cn-hangzhou --EndpointGroupConfigurations.1.Name test --EndpointGroupConfigurations.1.Description test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --EndpointGroupConfigurations.1.EndpointGroupRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --AcceleratorId 'ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000' --ListenerId 'lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000'
description_en: Invokes the CreateCustomRoutingEndpointGroups operation to create endpoint groups for custom routing listeners in batches
description_zh: 调用CreateCustomRoutingEndpointGroups接口批量创建自定义路由类型监听的终端节点组
kebab_example: aliyun ga create-custom-routing-endpoint-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --endpoint-group-configurations '[{"EndpointGroupRegion":"cn-hangzhou","Description":"test","DestinationConfigurations":[{}],"EndpointConfigurations":[{}],"Name":"test"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomRoutingEndpointGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not set this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run and does not create the endpoint groups for the custom routing listener. The system checks whether required parameters are set, the request format, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a Normal request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the endpoint groups for the custom routing listener are created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建自定义路由类型终端节点组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接创建自定义路由类型终端节点组
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Global Accelerator (GA)
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom routing listener
parameters.name: listener_id

fields.help_en:
The description of the endpoint group.

The description can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify descriptions for up to 5 endpoint groups
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组的描述信息。

描述长度最大256字符，不能包含`http://`和`https://`字符。

最多可以输入5个终端节点组的描述信息
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The start port of the backend service in the endpoint group.

Valid values: 1 to 65499. The value of FromPort must be less than or equal to the value of ToPort, which means the start port must be less than or equal to the end port of the backend service in the endpoint group.

You can specify up to 20 start ports of the backend service for each endpoint group
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组后端服务起始端口。

取值范围：1~65499，且需满足FromPort≤ToPort，即终端节点组后端服务起始端口需小于等于终端节点组后端服务结束端口。

每个终端节点组下，最多可输入20条后端服务起始端口信息
fields.name: from_port

fields.help_en:
The backend protocol type (Terms of Service) in the endpoint group.

You can specify up to 4 backend protocol types (Terms of Service) for each mapping port range and protocol type configuration in the endpoint group
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组后端服务的协议类型。

每个终端节点组映射端口范围和协议类型信息中，最多可以输入4个后端服务协议类型
fields.name: protocols

fields.help_en:
The end port of the backend service in the endpoint group.

Valid values: 1 to 65499. The value of FromPort must be less than or equal to the value of ToPort, which means the start port must be less than or equal to the end port of the backend service in the endpoint group.

You can specify up to 20 end ports of the backend service for each endpoint group
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组后端服务结束端口。

取值范围：1~65499，且需满足FromPort≤ToPort，即终端节点组后端服务起始端口需小于等于终端节点组后端服务结束端口。

每个终端节点组下，最多可输入20条后端服务结束端口信息
fields.name: to_port

fields.help_en:
The mapping configurations of the endpoint group.

You must specify service port range and protocol type of the backend service in the endpoint group. The specified information forms a mapping relationship with service port range of the associated listener.

You can specify up to 20 mapping port ranges and protocol types for each endpoint group
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组的映射信息配置。

您需要输入终端节点组后端服务端口范围和协议类型，输入信息与关联的监听端口范围将形成映射关系。

每个终端节点组下，最多可输入20条映射端口范围和协议类型信息
fields.name: destination_configurations

fields.help_en: The name of the vSwitch instance that serves as the endpoint
fields.help_zh: 终端节点交换机（vSwitch）实例名称
fields.name: endpoint

fields.help_en:
The IP address of the traffic destination that is allowed to receive access traffic.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify up to 20 IP addresses of traffic destinations for each endpoint
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标IP地址。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy取值为AllowCustom时，该项生效。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标IP地址
fields.name: address

fields.help_en:
The service port of the traffic destination that is allowed to receive access traffic. The port value must fall within the port range of the backend service in the endpoint group.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify port ranges for up to 20 traffic destinations for each endpoint, and up to 5 service ports for each traffic destination
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标的起始端口。该端口取值必须属于终端节点组后端服务端口范围。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy取值为AllowCustom时，该项生效。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标的端口范围，每个通行目标最多可输入5个起始端口
fields.name: from_port

fields.help_en:
The service port of the traffic destination that is allowed to receive access traffic. The port value must fall within the port range of the backend service in the endpoint group.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify port ranges for up to 20 traffic destinations for each endpoint, and up to 5 service ports for each traffic destination
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标的结束端口。该端口取值必须属于终端节点组后端服务端口范围。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy取值为AllowCustom时，该项生效。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标的端口范围，每个通行目标最多可输入5个结束端口
fields.name: to_port

fields.help_en:
Service port range of the traffic destination that is allowed to receive access traffic. Service port range must fall within service port range of the backend service in the endpoint group.

If this parameter is left empty, all ports of the traffic destination are supported.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify port ranges for up to 20 traffic destinations for each endpoint, and up to 5 port ranges for each traffic destination
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标端口范围。该端口范围必须属于终端节点组后端服务端口范围。

输入为空时，表示支持该通行目标的所有端口。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy取值为AllowCustom时，该项生效。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标的端口范围，每个通行目标最多可输入5个端口范围
fields.name: port_ranges

fields.help_en:
The traffic destination configurations.

You can specify up to 20 traffic destinations for each endpoint
fields.help_zh:
流量通行目标配置。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标
fields.name: policy_configurations

fields.help_en:
The traffic policy for the backend service. Valid values:

AllowAll: allows all access traffic to access the specified backend service.

DenyAll (default): denies all access traffic from accessing the specified backend service.

AllowCustom: specifies the traffic destinations that are allowed to receive access traffic.
You must specify the IP address and port range of the traffic destination. If the port range is left empty, all ports of the traffic destination are supported
fields.help_zh:
后端服务流量通行策略，取值：

AllowAll：允许所有访问流量访问指定后端服务。

DenyAll（默认值）：拒绝所有访问流量访问指定后端服务。

AllowCustom：指定可以接收访问流量的通行目标。
您需要指定该通信目标的IP地址和端口范围，端口范围输入为空时，表示支持该通行目标的所有端口
fields.name: traffic_to_endpoint_policy

fields.help_en:
The backend service type of the endpoint. Valid values:

PrivateSubNet (default): private CIDR block
fields.help_zh:
终端节点后端服务类型。取值：

 PrivateSubNet（默认值）：私网CIDR
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The endpoint configurations.

You can specify configurations for up to 10 endpoints in each endpoint group
fields.help_zh:
终端节点信息。

每个终端节点组下，最多可输入10个终端节点信息
fields.name: endpoint_configurations

fields.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint group.

You can specify region IDs for up to 5 endpoint groups
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组所属地域ID。

您最多可以输入5个终端节点组地域ID
fields.name: endpoint_group_region

fields.help_en:
The name of the endpoint group.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

You can enter up to five endpoint group names
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

最多可以输入5个终端节点组名称
fields.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint group configurations.

You can specify configurations for up to 5 endpoint groups
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组信息。

您最多可以输入5个终端节点组信息
parameters.name: endpoint_group_configurations

EndpointGroupIds.description_en: The list of endpoint group IDs

items.description_en: The list of endpoint group IDs
